exclusions.reason: **Breaking.** Split `release.py` (1985 lines) into a 6-module `release/` package: `__init__.py` (orchestrator), `execute.py`, `validate.py`, `hooks.py`, `publish.py`, `rollback.py`. Replaced the 24-parameter `_run_release_mutating` signature with a `ReleaseState` dataclass. Converted 27 `sys.exit` calls to `ReleaseValidationError`/`HookError` exceptions.
